subject: general
question: Two trains, 136 metres and 144 metres in length are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 65 km/hr and the second at the rate of 79 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?3629
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 136 + 144 = 280 m

Relative speed (opposite) = 65 + 79 = 144 km/hr

Convert speed: 144 × (5/18) = 40 m/s

Time = 280 ÷ 40 = 7 sec

**∴ Answer = 7 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of trains = 136 m and 144 m

Speeds = 65 km/hr and 79 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 136 + 144 = 280 m

⇒ Relative speed (opposite direction) = 65 + 79 = 144 km/hr

⇒ Convert into m/s: 144 × 5 ÷ 18 = 40 m/s

⇒ Time = 280 ÷ 40 = 7 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 7 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add: Relative speed = v1 + v2

Train Crossing Rule

When two trains cross, total distance = sum of their lengths

Speed Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18

Time Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Speed
